max_temp_prediction: Weighing the NWS forecast (90°F), the ECMWF/NBM range (88.7–90.1°F), and the dampening effect of 62% cloud fraction, the most likely daily high falls in the 88–90°F range, with the 88–89°F even bucket carrying the highest probability per the intraday model (50%) followed by the 90–91°F bucket (20%).
